options.description: The server process: listener, state folder, environments and master key.
options.name: core

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_HOST: Address the listener binds.
settings.name: host

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_PORT: Port the listener binds.
settings.name: port

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_BASE_DIR: The state folder.
settings.name: baseDir

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_DEPLOYMENT_MODE: local or cloud.
settings.name: deploymentMode

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_CONFIG_FILE: Optional JSON file with host, port, baseDir, deploymentMode, idle and Redis defaults.
settings.name: configFile

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ENVIRONMENTS_FILE: File listing the environments served (or set environmentId).
settings.name: environmentsFile

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ENVIRONMENT_ID: The single environment served when no environments file is given.
settings.name: environmentId

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ENVIRONMENT_DISPLAY_NAME: Display name of that single environment (defaults to its id).
settings.name: environmentDisplayName

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_MASTER_KEY_FILE: The 32-byte master key (a mounted secret file; PRAGMATIC_MASTER_KEY_B64_ENV may name an environment variable holding it instead).
settings.name: masterKey

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_PROVISIONED_SECRETS_FILE: The provisioned connection secrets (a mounted secret file).
settings.name: provisionedSecrets

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: Browser origins allowed to connect (comma-separated).
settings.name: allowedOrigins

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDLE_TTL_MS: An environment idle this many milliseconds is unloaded.
settings.name: idleTtlMs

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDLE_SWEEP_MS: Interval of the idle sweep in milliseconds.
settings.name: idleSweepMs

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS: How long shutdown waits for connections to drain, in milliseconds.
settings.name: drainTimeoutMs

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_HEALTH_PORT: Separate port for /healthz and /readyz (served on the main listener when unset).
settings.name: healthPort

options.description: Gateway and workers sharing a Redis worker directory.
options.name: cluster

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_REDIS_URL: The Redis URL of the worker directory.
settings.name: redisUrl

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_REPLICA_ID: The id of this replica (defaults to HOSTNAME, else a random id).
settings.name: replicaId

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_WORKER_ADVERTISE_HOST: Host the gateway reaches this worker on.
settings.name: workerAdvertiseHost

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_WORKER_ADVERTISE_PORT: Port the gateway reaches this worker on.
settings.name: workerAdvertisePort

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_WORKER_SERVERNAME: TLS server name of the workers.
settings.name: workerServerName

options.description: Mutual TLS between the gateway and the workers (the server side).
options.name: tls

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TLS_CERT_FILE: Path of the PEM certificate this process presents.
settings.name: certificateFile

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TLS_KEY_FILE: The PEM private key of that certificate (a mounted secret file).
settings.name: privateKey

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TLS_CA_FILE: Path of the PEM CA bundle peers are verified against.
settings.name: caFile

options.description: The client certificate this process presents when it connects to another cluster member.
options.name: clientTls

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_CLIENT_TLS_CERT_FILE: Path of the PEM client certificate.
settings.name: certificateFile

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_CLIENT_TLS_KEY_FILE: The PEM private key of the client certificate (a mounted secret file).
settings.name: privateKey

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_CLIENT_TLS_CA_FILE: Path of the PEM CA bundle the server is verified against.
settings.name: caFile

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_SERVICE_NAME: The service name reported with metrics and traces.
settings.name: serviceName

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_METRICS_PORT: Port of the Prometheus metrics listener (off when unset).
settings.name: metricsPort

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_OTLP_ENDPOINT: OTLP collector endpoint (no export when unset).
settings.name: otlpEndpoint

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_OTLP_PROTOCOL: OTLP protocol: http-protobuf or grpc.
settings.name: otlpProtocol

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_OTLP_METRICS: Whether metrics are also exported over OTLP.
settings.name: otlpMetrics

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TRACE_SAMPLING: Trace sampling ratio between 0 and 1.
settings.name: traceSampling

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_AUDIT_SINK: none, file or sql (sql needs deploymentMode cloud).
settings.name: sink

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_AUDIT_FILE: The audit file (required for sink file).
settings.name: file

options.description: Request rate limits, each an Rps + Burst pair.
options.name: rateLimit

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_RATELIMIT_ENVIRONMENT_RPS: Requests per second per environment (a number greater than 0).
settings.name: environmentRps

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_RATELIMIT_ENVIRONMENT_BURST: Burst per environment (at least 1).
settings.name: environmentBurst

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_RATELIMIT_PRINCIPAL_RPS: Requests per second per principal (a number greater than 0).
settings.name: principalRps

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_RATELIMIT_PRINCIPAL_BURST: Burst per principal (at least 1).
settings.name: principalBurst

options.description: WebSocket heartbeat, idle and back-pressure limits.
options.name: webSocket

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_WS_HEARTBEAT_MS: Heartbeat interval in milliseconds.
settings.name: heartbeatMs

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_WS_READ_IDLE_MS: A connection silent for this many milliseconds is closed.
settings.name: readIdleMs

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_WS_BP_SOFT_BYTES: Buffered bytes at which a slow connection is paused.
settings.name: backpressureSoftBytes

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_WS_BP_HARD_BYTES: Buffered bytes at which a slow connection is closed.
settings.name: backpressureHardBytes

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_WS_BP_GRACE_MS: How long a connection may stay over the soft limit, in milliseconds.
settings.name: backpressureGraceMs

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_WS_MAX_INBOUND_BYTES: Largest inbound message in bytes.
settings.name: maxInboundBytes

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_PAGE_SIZE_DEFAULT: Default page size.
settings.name: pageSizeDefault

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_PAGE_SIZE_MAX: Largest page size a request may ask for.
settings.name: pageSizeMax

options.description: Signed connector adapter packs, loaded into a sandbox.
options.name: adapterPacks

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADAPTER_PACKS_DIR: The pack cache folder (the feature is off without it).
settings.name: cacheDir

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADAPTER_PACKS_SANDBOX: worker or child.
settings.name: sandbox

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADAPTER_PACKS_REQUIRE_SIGNATURES: Refuse unsigned packs.
settings.name: requireSignatures

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADAPTER_PACKS_MAX_OLD_MB: Old-generation heap limit of a pack, in MB.
settings.name: maxOldMb

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADAPTER_PACKS_MAX_YOUNG_MB: Young-generation heap limit of a pack, in MB.
settings.name: maxYoungMb

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADAPTER_PACKS_STACK_MB: Stack limit of a pack, in MB.
settings.name: stackMb

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADAPTER_PACKS_EVICT_MAX_VERSIONS: Versions of one pack kept in the cache.
settings.name: evictMaxVersions

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADAPTER_PACKS_EVICT_MAX_AGE_MS: Age in milliseconds after which an unused pack version is evicted.
settings.name: evictMaxAgeMs

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADAPTER_PACKS_SCRIPT_ALLOWLIST: Packs allowed to run scripts (comma-separated names).
settings.name: scriptAllowlist

options.description: Cloud deployment (deploymentMode cloud): the provider and its key references; the option of the provider holds the rest.
options.name: cloud

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_CLOUD_PROVIDER: gcp, aws or azure.

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_CLOUD_MASTER_KEY_REF: The provider KMS key that wraps the master key.

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_CLOUD_AUDIT_ANCHOR_KEY_REF: The KMS key that signs audit anchors.
settings.name: auditAnchorKeyRef

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_CLOUD_AUDIT_ANCHOR_INTERVAL: Audit records between two anchors (at least 1).
settings.name: auditAnchorInterval

options.name: azure

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_AZPG_PORT: The Postgres port.

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_AZPG_USER: The database user.
